_comment: Source of truth for what the ambimat.com front page SHOULD and SHOULD NOT serve.
Derived verbatim from the Gate C read-only evidence of 2026-07-31 (front-page natural
Nothing here is invented: every path segment and attachment id below was proven in that
run by matching the served URL path segment against wp_postmeta._wp_attached_file.
This file is DATA ONLY. It grants no authority to change anything on the server.

obsolete_images.note: Stale front-page social image observed in the pre-write W3TC cache entry on 2026-07-31.

twitter_image.note: The installed stack emitted NO twitter:image tag on 2026-07-31. Absence is therefore accepted (not an alert); a PRESENT tag pointing at an obsolete image IS an alert.

schema_image.note: Primary (non-logo) schema contentUrl. Already governed on 2026-07-31 because it derives from the featured image.
